subject: youtube.channel.behind_the_system
summary: «العالم خلف الستار» is an evergreen hidden-systems/infrastructure channel explaining how unseen systems move matter, money, energy or data from an everyday action to its result.

details.audience: Arabic 18–45 general-curiosity viewers plus students, engineers and employees interested in how real-world systems work
details.narrative: everyday action -> go behind the screen/wall -> follow 4–6 system nodes -> biggest failure point -> return to everyday scene with new meaning
details.visual_direction: industrial editorial; technical blue + safety orange; isometric maps, arrows, cross-sections, process icons and large infrastructure
details.visual_rule: every diagram must explain movement of material, money, energy or data
pilot: 7 min: how does the internet actually reach your phone?
Short: what happens to your bag after the black conveyor belt?
6 min: journey of an online order from factory to your door
